title: Execution-Bound Evidence
finding: A verification receipt is a claim about an execution, not proof that the execution happened.
predicate: VERIFIED = trusted(C AND R AND A AND S AND H)

predicates.C: receipt commit equals independently sourced workflow head SHA
predicates.R: receipt run ID and attempt equal workflow run ID and attempt
predicates.A: workflow status is completed and conclusion is success
predicates.S: all required suites are independently evidenced as passed
predicates.H: actual artifact digest equals receipt expected digest

limits: JSON receipt alone does not authenticate its issuer
Workflow conclusion alone does not prove every required test command ran
The verifier relies on its caller to supply independently sourced evidence
This is software assurance, not physical or quantum-geometry validation
